email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing Coordinator (Benelux & Nordics) role. I'm a digital marketer based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, working where content, campaigns and web performance meet — currently across client sites in WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify.

What attracts me is the shape of the job: regional coordination, events, content localisation and reporting, all sitting close to the sales teams. Today I manage content calendars, publish and update pages, run SEO and campaign reporting in Google Analytics and Search Console, and keep stakeholders across different countries aligned.

I'd bring the organised, hands-on approach the role needs, plus a real interest in the veterinary and healthcare space — I built front-end features for a healthcare web application early in my career.

I'd welcome the chance to talk.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing Coordinator (Benelux & Nordics) position. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and I work across SEO, content, web and AI-assisted automation — the practical side of getting campaigns and content out the door, then measuring what they did.

Three things make me a good fit for the coordination side of this role. First, I'm used to working across markets and teams: at Knowledge Experts I supported digital workplace builds for large organisations, and today I handle SEO, content and CMS work for clients in several countries, coordinating with the people who own the commercial side. Second, I own content end to end — writing and adapting pages and blog posts in WordPress and Shopify, keeping messaging consistent, and reporting results in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. Third, I hold a HubSpot Content Marketing certification, so marketing platforms and CRM are familiar ground rather than new territory.

On events, I'll be straightforward: I haven't run congresses or exhibitions at scale yet. I have delivered projects where logistics, timelines, suppliers and post-launch follow-up all had to line up, and I'm keen to build that experience properly.

Healthcare and life sciences interest me — my first developer role was on a Belgian healthcare web application — and the veterinary sector's mix of technology, clinical education and hands-on customer support genuinely appeals to me.

I'm fluent in English, based in Belgium and happy to travel regularly across Benelux and occasionally further. My Dutch is at B1 writing and A2+ speaking and improving steadily, so I can work in Dutch day to day while I build it up.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss the role.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cv_highlights:
- Multi-market delivery: SEO, content and CMS work for client websites across Turkey, Belgium and international teams, coordinating with commercial and technical stakeholders.
- Content and CMS ownership end to end: WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), WooCommerce and Shopify — publishing pages, blog content and product catalogues, and keeping existing content current.
- Performance tracking and reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Semrush and Ahrefs; HubSpot Content Marketing certified.
- Project delivery with logistics and follow-up: SharePoint-based digital workplace platforms for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff) as part of a team, plus a ~600-page member profile site for a pharmacists' association.
- Healthcare and technology background: front-end developer on a Belgian healthcare web application (2018-2019); based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, fluent English, Dutch improving (B1 writing / A2+ speaking), available for regular Benelux travel.
